In detail

Casal Boccone is a small, largely residential enclave better known locally for a notoriously dangerous stretch of road than for street crime. However, in April 2025 police arrested a 26-year-old after finding 46 kg of drugs and roughly 265,000 euros in cash in a home there, a substantial and well-documented drug-trafficking bust. Day-to-day public safety reporting is otherwise limited to a resolved missing-person case and road-safety campaigns, with no reports of street violence.
